name: Agentic Teams
description: A modular plugin that packs specialised agents into teams and allows user to interact with them at the higher level of abstraction. Like with real-world company departments.
longDescription:
Ships **1 skill**, **9 agents** and **11 commands**.

- **Skills** (1): `team-workflow` (Auto-invoked when the user asks for feature development, building something, creating a new system, implementing a feature, or…)
- **Agents** (9): `architect` (Designs system architecture, defines API contracts, makes technology decisions, and ensures scalability, maintainability, and coherence across the codebase), `backend` (Implements server-side code, APIs, database operations, and business logic), `frontend` (Implements client-side code, UI components, state management, and user interactions), `product-manager` (Defines requirements, writes user stories, sets acceptance criteria, and prioritizes work), `qa` (Reviews code quality, writes comprehensive tests, identifies edge cases and bugs, and validates that acceptance criteria are met…), `security` (Performs threat modeling, vulnerability analysis, security code review, and ensures compliance with security best practices before deployment), `team-manager` (Routing helper that assesses a task and recommends which agents to invoke and in what order), `ui-designer` (Designs UI components, defines visual specs, ensures accessibility and responsive layouts), and 1 more
- **Commands** (11): `architect` (Run the Architect agent for system design, API contracts, and tech decisions), `backend` (Run the Backend Developer agent to implement server-side code), `build` (Run the full development team pipeline on a task), `design` (Run the UI Designer agent to create component specs, layouts, and visual design tokens), `frontend` (Run the Frontend Developer agent to implement client-side code), `pm` (Run the Product Manager agent to define requirements and acceptance criteria), `prototype` (Build a clickable interactive prototype to validate design direction before full implementation), `qa` (Run the QA Engineer agent to review code, write tests, and validate acceptance criteria), and 3 more

Installs with `claude plugin install agentic-teams@claude-community` from `rustamfi/agentic-teams` (`plugins/dev-team`).
